notes_for_editor: Only two listing pages support the story; neither dates the replica or names its builder. The Fire Lookout Association Washington list (https://firelookout.org/lookouts/us/wa/) shows 'Newport (Replica)' as a standing tower at these coordinates, but its row was not quoted, so it is not cited. No source found describes an original Newport lookout, so the story does not discuss one. The scenicwa.com page shows weekly hours with no date; the story mentions that they are undated and does not give them. That page also lists a second number, (509) 995-9389, without saying which entity it belongs to, so the story gives only (509) 447-5388 as a contact number. The word 'outdoor' was removed: no source read describes the exhibits as outdoor. Call ahead to check hours and whether the replica is open to climb or only to view.
